title: Milke kaho ya Hussain kehte raho Ya hussain
body:
Karbala walo'n ka maatam hai hamaari zindagi
karbala walo'n pa roona hai hamaari bandagi
hai yahi ajre risaalat qalq ko batlaayenge
<<MINI>>
